name: Saotome Ranma
source: Ranma is the heir of the Saotome-ryu style and a master of martial arts. After falling into the cursed springs of Jusenkyo in China, they developed a body constitution that transforms them into a girl when splashed with cold water. Akane is their childhood fiancée, a marriage arrangement predetermined by their parents. Currently, Ranma lives with their father as a guest at the Tendo family household.
